props.gloss_en: one with extra digits on hands and feet, six and six -- twenty-four: R' Yehuda deems him fit
R' Yitzchak: and both expounded one verse -- 'and there was again war... and there was a man of stature, the fingers of his hands and the toes of his feet six and six' (II Sam 21:20)
one master holds: [the verse] speaks of his disgrace
and one master holds: it speaks of his praise
the verse's wording: 'six and six, twenty-four in number' (II Sam 21:20)
Rabba: had the Merciful One written 'six and six' I would say six of his hand and six of his foot -- so it wrote 'twenty-four'
Rabba: had it written 'twenty-four' I would say five on this side and seven on that -- so it wrote 'six and six'
Rabba: 'in number' -- [the extra digit] counted along the back of the hand
R' Yehuda: a man came before R' Tarfon with extra digits on hands and feet, six and six, twenty-four
[R' Tarfon] said to him: may [men] like you increase in Israel
R' Yosei: this is what he said to him: may mamzerim and netinim in Israel be as few as [men like] you
